intended_behavior.objective: Harden the calibration evaluator trust boundary and evidence provenance on the focused feature branch.
deliverables: Fail-closed path resolution rejecting traversal, absolute paths, and symlinks in every component before following them.
Exact integrity-manifest artifact_digests schema (run_manifest.json, coordinate_manifest.json, calibration_results.json; reject missing/extra/malformed/unsafe/symlink).
Recursive MANIFEST.sha256 verification failing closed on unexpected filesystem objects.
Cross-manifest consistency across integrity/coordinate/results and per-target records (counts, statuses, IDs; boolean-as-int rejection).
Update evaluate.py input documentation to list all four bound run_inputs digest fields.
Adversarial tests: in-root/escaping/parent/root symlinks, exact-schema missing/extra, count/status and cross-manifest mismatches, reachable code-SHA tamper check.

security_risks: Path traversal / symlink escape via MANIFEST.sha256 or evidence references (mitigated by fail-closed component-wise symlink and containment checks).

Artifact/evidence substitution when dependent digests are rewritten together (mitigated by binding run identity and code provenance to a trusted source; evaluator not presented as an approved authoritative path until that binding is trusted).
Self-reference between MANIFEST.sha256 and the integrity manifest's own digest fields (kept separate).
Oversights in aggregate-only cross-manifest checks (mitigated by per-target ID/status and counter-consistency reconciliation).
test_plan: Package manifest check (scripts/ci/manifest_check.py) after regenerating SHA256SUMS.
Evidence-sequence checker (scripts/ci/evidence_sequence_check.py) in a clean checkout before pushing.
acceptance_criteria: All evaluator tests pass; new adversarial tests assert the intended failure branch/message.
Full backend suite shows no new regressions attributable to this change.
Package manifest regenerated deterministically; manifest_check passes.
Push-log records reconciled truthfully; current-tip declared; evidence-sequence checker passes in clean checkout.
rollback_strategy: The change is isolated to feature/evaluator-trust-boundary (append-only commits; no force-push). Rollback = do not merge and close the branch, or revert forward via a reviewed follow-up on the same reviewed path; historical log entries are preserved byte-for-byte.
